entries.129453407ddbf211: It produces video content. Bakku Suteji Co., Ltd. is in charge of this.
entries.56002f776cce365f: This business provides maintenance of manufacturing equipment and its accessories, overhaul of vacuum pumps, total chemical management covering management and transport of chemical liquids, and contract operation management and maintenance of ultrapure water plants, among others. It is handled by JM Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Kusunoki Kemiko Co., Ltd., PEK Co., Ltd. and a group of subsidiaries in Singapore.
entries.80e7f1e771721fdd: It develops three-dimensional tool software for CADCAM, undertakes contract development of application software for three-dimensional data processing, and sells three-dimensional CAD viewer software. Shisetto Co., Ltd. is in charge of this.
entries.8115db13829f4a12: Development of Three-Dimensional Data Processing Software
entries.8a58b2870fe95d5b: This business designs and constructs piping that connects specialty gas supply equipment to manufacturing equipment. Piping for ultrapure water, air, nitrogen, argon, chemical liquids, vacuum, exhaust and others is also covered; the company handles specialty gas piping, and Towa Shoko Co., Ltd. handles ultrapure water piping.
entries.8d84b09c2b706715: These services include replacing and collecting cylinders attached to specialty gas supply equipment, routine inspection and maintenance, and acting as agent for order management of specialty gases. For domestic manufacturers, the company and JM Tech Co., Ltd. handle these; for overseas manufacturers, Maotaili Keji Gufen Youxian Gongsi handles them.
entries.948ed01bd682a402: This is the main business. With specialty gases at its core, it provides infrastructure involving ultrapure water and chemical liquids, along with maintenance for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and the manufacture and sale of equipment maintenance parts, for semiconductor and liquid crystal plants and other facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥56,047 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.
entries.b2eadcf516262f84: A company that provides specialty gas supply equipment, piping work and factory operation services for semiconductor factories in an integrated manner.
entries.b5412470d5707aee: This business develops and manufactures specialty gas supply equipment, gas distributors, and abatement equipment, among others, for supplying specialty gases safely, stably and without compromising purity. The company is in charge of this.
entries.cfec20bbc977d215: Sales of IT and Video-Related Equipment
entries.d560af2599ca2204: This business sells IT and video-related equipment, such as digital signage players, multi-display controllers and encoders and decoders for streaming distribution; sells software for the broadcasting industry; develops three-dimensional data processing software; and produces video content. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,719 million.
entries.fbbaf086ebe98443: This business sells electricity generated by solar power to electric power companies. The company is in charge of this, and three solar power plants are operating in Mie Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥209 million.
entries.fc639bf1861a4b76: Led by the digital signage player BrightSign, it sells, develops applications for, and maintains IT and video-related equipment handled in partnership with manufacturers around the world. The company is in charge of this.
